headSubject: feat(REG-197): rename candidate scorer + suggest/accept CLI path (B1, package 2.2)
summary: Implemented and shipped Wave 2 package 2.2 of BOUNDARY_LIFT_PLAN_2026-09-02.md: B8 was the wrong precedent to copy -- B1 (REG-197) built RenameCandidateScorer in the DSL module (7-signal scoring, every signal shown not just a total), wired it into both ImpactReportText (RuntimeHost, live-DB) and MigrationPlanEmitter (generator, model-vs-model) so they share one scorer instead of two heuristics, added npdev migration diff --suggest-renames and npdev migrate rename --from-suggestions to the CLI, and updated all four register seams (B1 stays HITTABLE per the plan -- only the friction around satisfying it is gone). Closing verification found and fixed two real gaps: an existing ImpactReportRenderersTest whose three rename tests assumed the OLD all-in-one heuristic (rewrote them against the new scorer-computes/renderer-renders split, plus added a missing RenameCandidateAnalysisTest that should have existed from the start), and a hung background gate process caused by MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 breaking git clone file:// URLs in the pack-signing test suite (env var was carried over from an unrelated earlier fix, not needed for pwsh -File; new memory note written so this is not rediscovered). Commit 324c447a pushed to main; working tree clean.
nextStep: Package 2.2's plan done-when #5 (an opt-in --accept-above <score> flag for disposable dev databases only, refusing on any non-dev target) was deliberately deferred as its own live-database-write safety feature needing separate review -- not started, no design done yet. Otherwise package 2.2 is fully closed. Next up per BOUNDARY_LIFT_PLAN_2026-09-02.md section 3's wave plan: package 2.3 (B5-A, per-boot schema snapshot + precise schema-ahead diagnosis, M-L effort, depends on 2.1's shared diff surface which is done) is the last Wave-2 package, OR jump to Wave 1's still-open packages (1.1 B19 band-picker-without-panel, 1.2 B9 bulk-snapshot-restore, 1.3 B30-A plugin-limits-on-by-default, 1.4 B17 first-run-admin-bootstrap -- all independently shippable, no shared foundation needed). Read section 3's 'Recommended first three' line (1.3, 1.2, 1.1) if picking a Wave-1 package instead of continuing Wave 2.
verified: run-all-gates.ps1 (T2): generator PASSED, kernel PASSED (both from the first full run, untouched since), runtimeHost PASSED (rerun clean after fixing ImpactReportRenderersTest), aiKnowledge PASSED (rerun clean after removing a stray MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 that was breaking git clone in 9 pack-signing/catalog/lock-tamper/publish tests -- confirmed as the root cause by isolating those 4 test files, which passed standalone, then reproducing green on the full gate without the env var). ALL 4 T2 GATES GREEN on the final committed code. Also: check-twin-pair-consistency.py (33/33 OK, including the new rule), check-done-item-guards.py, check-doc-inventory.py, check-no-markdown-reads.py, check-schema-mirror-consistency.py, and a jsonschema meta-validation plus sample-payload validation of both edited schema files -- all clean.
